Interface PlayerStorage

All Superinterfaces:
Storage
public interface PlayerStorage extends Storage
Marks a Storage as the player inventory side of a menu, as opposed to the container side.

CustomContainerMenu's shift-click routing uses it to send items from the player side to the container, and from the container side to the player.

Storage from StorageAttachment.playerAttached(String, String, int) implements this marker. Consumers with their own player-backed Storage (through StorageAttachment.custom(...) or a direct Storage implementation) should implement it too if that Storage stands for the player's inventory when shift-clicking.

This was once a concrete class with its own item list and save and load methods. It remains as a marker because shift-click routing needs to tell player storage from container storage, and the narrow Storage interface doesn't say which is which.
